status: 18 scoped source/native reviews; seven native query/read corrections; grouped build passes 15,169 fixed slots.

source_reviews.name: effect_nobody_can_attack_until_eot
source_reviews.reason: Native uses separate own-instance lookups for begin-turn marker writes and cleanup marker read, while other countdown/flag operations retain the entry pointer. Restore those queries at native 0x2677764/0x26778e4 and 0x26777cb; preserve saved end_effect and post-kill flag reloads.

source_reviews.name: generic_painland
source_reviews.reason: COUNT_MANA native first gets instance and tests contamination (0x26822a7), then queries instance again for mana_color on either branch (0x26822c3/0x26824ca). Recovery read colors before the contamination query. Restore flag-query-before-color-query order, preserving replacement loops, AI checks and repeated damage quirks.

source_reviews.name: cautery_sliver_shared_ability
source_reviews.reason: Native first checks targets[1].player, then gets instance again at 0x23b4542 before snapshotting source player/card for leaves_play and humiliation. Restore the second query while retaining all subsequent native sliver ownership/activation behavior.

source_reviews.name: card_isochron_scepter
source_reviews.reason: Native imprint path gets instance only after successful selection, then again after original-IID query for target store, and after exile for count increment (0x253f158/0x253f188/0x253f1b0). CAN_ACTIVATE calls generic ability before per-condition and per-item fresh getters (0x253f287/0x253f29c). Restore those query lifetimes and remove the pre-dispatch getter on cleanup; ACTIVATE and RESOLVE_ACTIVATION keep their own entry snapshots.

source_reviews.name: card_precursor_golem
source_reviews.reason: Native spell trigger uses four separate queries: target count, target-card sentinel, saved target card, then target player before subtype query (0x2446ff9/0x2447015/0x2447035/0x2447054). Restore query order instead of sharing one pointer. Keep exact !=-1 predicate and subsequent battlefield scan/copy logic.

source_reviews.name: damage_dealt_by_me_arbitrary
source_reviews.reason: Native dead-source attachment scan gets each candidate separately for kind, source player, source card and source-card write; second check similarly requeries target player/card. Restore five conditional getters (native 0x268e076/0x268e0b3/0x268e0c7/0x268e0db/0x268e1b8), keeping live bounds and existing aura/equipment rerouting.

source_reviews.name: reveal_card_until_you_reveal_test
source_reviews.reason: Packed-quantity mode preserves initial low byte for wanted count, but native reloads high byte from test->qty after count_deck (0x269ade9/0x269ae00). Recovery used the old full quantity snapshot for both. Restore live high-byte read while preserving saved deck pointer, later count calls, native VLA size and reveal/effect order.
